title: A Archive for the Echo
author: D. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Bram Okonkwo, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
